# Sub-agent handoff: task title

- Task/agent:
- Outcome: Complete | Partial | Blocked
- Module/plan/version:
- Requirements/acceptance IDs:
- Contracts/versions:
- Date:

## Delivered outcome

State observable behavior or planning result and important limitations. Do not claim completion from compilation or narrow tests alone.

## Scope and files

List files added/changed, generated artifacts and their sources, migrations, and intentionally untouched areas. Confirm unrelated user changes were preserved.

## Contract and compatibility report

List published/consumed changes, OpenAPI/event/provider/database/configuration impact, compatibility decisions, migration/rollback, and approvals. State `None` with rationale where appropriate.

## Evidence

Link the completed test-evidence record and summarize red/green/refactor, real DB/API/browser/platform/provider results. List every Failed, Blocked, and Not Run scenario explicitly.

## Security, privacy, dependency, and operations review

State findings, secret/content handling, new dependencies and admission records, logging/diagnostic effects, resource/backup/recovery impact, and runbook changes.

## Documentation and traceability

List requirements, acceptance criteria, ADRs, plans, contract catalogs, schemas, runbooks, and matrices updated.

## Risks, defects, and follow-up

List exact IDs, severity, owner, blocker, and recommended next step. Never hide an unresolved issue in prose.

## Integration instructions

Give the root steward the order of operations, commands once authoritative commands exist, environmental prerequisites, review focus, and rollback/recovery actions.

## Declaration

Confirm work stayed within assigned paths/authority, no secret was exposed, no prohibited test double or test manipulation was used, and no external state was changed beyond explicit authorization.
